fusions.name: Grapnel Cast
fusions.desc: Casts at the target for 13 damage, up to 1.6 times that at the full 7 tiles, and hauls you up to 5 tiles toward it. The target is [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagging Sweep
fusions.desc: Rakes every enemy within 2 tiles for 3 damage, each with a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeled In
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Landed Catch
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
